overview: SocialChain is an all-in-one social media platform with a built-in crypto wallet. Share posts with photos, connect with people via personalized invite links, and manage ICP, ckBTC, ckETH, ckUSDC, and ckUSDT — all in one place.
features: Text and photo social feed with likes and comments
User profiles with editable bio and avatar uploads
Multi-token crypto wallet (ICP, ckBTC, ckETH, ckUSDC, ckUSDT)
Live token balances with send/receive flows and transaction history
Personalized invite links for easy contact sharing
